episodes.synopsis: Koro Sensei and his students try some matchmaking at the end of their island trip. Class 3-E's eventful summer ends with a taste of pure festival fun.
episodes.title: Summer Festival Time

episodes.synopsis: Kaede comes up with a delicious plan of attack, Class 3-E plays an intense game of Cops and Robbers, and Koro Sensei is accused of a serious crime.
episodes.title: Kaede Time

episodes.synopsis: Koro Sensei faces off against the powerful, tentacled Itona and his handler Shiro yet again, revealing more of his teaching philosophy along the way.
episodes.title: Itona Horibe Time

episodes.synopsis: Itona endears himself to the boys in Class 3-E as he shows off his assassination creation. The students call each other code names for an entire day.
episodes.title: Spinning Time

episodes.synopsis: Competition between the elite A Class and downtrodden E Class heats up at the school sports festival, with Isogai's livelihood hanging in the balance.
episodes.title: Leader Time

episodes.synopsis: After an accident, the E Class winds up doing a whole different kind of studying off campus. But will they have a chance to bone up for the midterms?
episodes.title: Before & After Time

episodes.synopsis: A well-intentioned act leads to a falling-out with Professor Bitch. Soon the E Class finds itself facing off alone against a formidable assassin foe.
episodes.title: Reaper Time, Part 1

episodes.synopsis: When Koro Sensei and Mr. Karasuma reach the Reaper's hideout, it's anyone's guess who'll come out on top--especially with wild-card Irina in the mix.
episodes.title: Reaper Time, Part 2

episodes.synopsis: The students consider their future career options. Nagisa struggles to come to terms with his talent; meanwhile, his mother has her own plans for him.
episodes.title: Round Two Time

episodes.synopsis: Each class at Kunugigaoka Academy is competing for the highest sales totals in the school festival. How can the E Class even hope to stand a chance?
episodes.title: School Festival Time

episodes.synopsis: It's exam time again, and the cream-of-the-crop A Class is a bigger threat than ever before. Top-ranking Asano, however, has something up his sleeve.
episodes.title: End-of-Term Time - Second Period

episodes.synopsis: The end-of-term exams come down to one doozy of a final problem. Principal Asano comes to Koro Sensei with a little wager that has a lot riding on it.
episodes.title: Think Outside the Box Time

episodes.synopsis: Principal Asano recalls his first foray into the world of education. In the drama festival, the E Class puts on a play with a few unexpected twists.
episodes.title: Let Live Time

episodes.synopsis: Following the drama festival, the E Class learn that one of their classmates is hiding a big secret connected to Koro Sensei's past!
episodes.title: Secret Identity Time

episodes.synopsis: Koro Sensei begins to come clean about his background after a tense and terrifying encounter with a student who has her own reasons to kill him.
episodes.title: Confession Time

episodes.synopsis: Following the traumatic story of Koro Sensei's past, the E Class is left reeling after learning revelations about his past deeds and identity. As the gather themselves with this new information, it begins to affect their assassination plans.
episodes.title: Past Time

episodes.synopsis: The E class is divided over whether to kill Koro Sensei or try to save him. Koro Sensei suggests a way of settling the issue between the two sides.
episodes.title: Discord Time

episodes.synopsis: The battle amongst the E-Class comes down to the final two on each side: Karma vs. Nagisa. But, a new obstacle throws a wrench into the E Class's plans.
episodes.title: Outcome Time

episodes.synopsis: Class 3-E has agreed to try and save Koro Sensei. In order to do this, they must track down confidential information -- information that takes the class to another height.
episodes.title: Outer Space Time

episodes.synopsis: Nagisa remains uncertain about his future as high-school entrance exams loom over him. It's time for Class 3-E to celebrate Valentine's Day!
episodes.title: Valentine's Day Time

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the last project from Koro Sensei before the E-Class closes out the year, but the government's own plans and threatens to get in the way.
episodes.title: Trust Time

episodes.synopsis: The students fight to see their teacher one last time. A figure from Koro Sensei's past arrives with a serious grudge against the super-creature.
episodes.title: Happy Birthday Time

episodes.synopsis: A pitched battle between two super-creatures threatens to harm the students of Class 3-E. Can Koro Sensei protect them while fighting for his life?
episodes.title: Final Boss Time

episodes.synopsis: Time is running out, and the E Class students must decide once and for all whether to kill the teacher who so changed their lives over the past year.
episodes.title: Graduation Time

episodes.synopsis: Graduation day: one of life's chapters ends and another begins as the students and teachers of Class 3-E go on to forge their own paths in the world.
episodes.title: Future Time
